NYI.head: The matchup suits NY Islanders
NYI.body: NY Islanders has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Chicago can make it interesting if it pounces on loose pucks.

CHI.head: Chicago faces a real test
CHI.body: NY Islanders has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Chicago can pull it off if it pounces on loose pucks.
